This template can be used to easily externalize cross-namespace links from article space. [[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Avoid self-references|Wikipedia:Avoid self-references]] explains why these are undesirable; {{[[{{ns:Template}}:srlink|srlink]]&#124;Main Page}} displays as {{srlink|Main Page}} rather than [[Main Page]] but remains intact even on mirrors. Piping links are allowed: {{srlink|Main Page|Wookieepedia's Main Page}}.
